notes.title: Patch release 0.6.34
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue with portrait visuals after using Transform.
- Fixed an UI issue for the ability editor for attribute input fields.

notes.title: Version 0.6.33 is out!🍹
notes.notes:
- All default decks (Elf, Undead and Eternals) have been reworked and rebalanced.
- Mana compensation now show directly instead of after the turn ends. Mana compensation is the amount of mana a player receives when losing a unit based on its power level.
- Abilities: You can now spawn board effects at the current tile when using "To Path Tile".

notes.title: Release 0.6.32 brings a new Blind effect
notes.notes:
- New blind effect! (units affected by this can only move 1 tile at a time)
- Updated the fonts and how they are displayed for abilities
- Reworked the Elf Deck
- Fixed an issue with the wing animation not working if the unit it was last attached to got destroyed
- Mana cost evaluation issue resolved
- Fixed an issue occurring during leaving a waypoint

notes.title: Patch release 0.6.29
notes.notes:
- Added a graphics quality dropdown to the settings dialog.
- Fixed issues with lag in combination with sliding movement that spawns board effects.

notes.title: Patch release 0.6.28
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue with active abilities that "unblocks" units by destroying a unit that blocks its path, not showing those updated move targets after the destroy animation completed.
- Added support for better customizations of movement types for units.

notes.title: Version 0.6.25
notes.notes:
Adds support for using values/variables in abilities.

Example A:
Freeze all opponents in a forward pattern for X turns, where X is the number of surrounding allies.

Example B:
Subtract opponent mana by X, where X is the number of frozen undead units on the board.

notes.title: Patch release 0.6.24
notes.notes:
- Hotseat and Practice menus now support selecting a map
- Various UI fixes
- Increased UI sharpness with the temporary side effect of removing UI transitions
- Fixed a tooltip issue in the ability editor
- Poison ability caused a crash during a special condition

notes.title: Version 0.6.21 is here, bringing you a simplified mana system.
notes.notes:
- The current mana system seemed good in theory, but didn't turn out so well in practice. We have simplified it by removing the need to manually assign mana to units. Instead, units spend mana through a shared pool, removing the need of first assigning it before you can use it.

- Players have a max value cap of 15 mana, encouraging players to spend it, rather than hoard it.

- Compensation mana is now granted to players when a unit is lost. The amount is based on the units power level (PL). 100 PL = 1 mana. 200 PL = 2 mana etc. It increases the chance of a comeback for players when they suffer a loss.

- Bugfix: Poison and Fatigue resulted in errors for certain type of abilities that evaluated state during the end turn phase.

notes.title: Bugfixes
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue with local packs not showing in dropdowns
- Fixed a potential issue with old decks not being possible to save or clone

notes.title: Minor bugfixes
notes.notes: - Fixed an issue with win conditions not evaluated correctly during a draw

notes.title: Bugfix
notes.notes: - If, for some reason, one of your unit portraits gets deleted, the game will now handle it by setting the portrait to a default one, instead of crashing.

notes.title: Improved UX and bugfixes
notes.notes:
- Improved board readability with opponents decorated with a red gem
- Fixed an issue where clicking the "online" button didnt work
- Fixed an issue where the close/cancel option in the "end the match" dialog didnt work

notes.title: Bugfixes
notes.notes:
- When selecting where to move you unit with overlapping sliding moves, the game now pick the move that is closest to the player, instead of the one thats further away.

- Practice mode: There was a chance for the AI to make 2 moves on the same turn after a previous improvement where the local matches became more responsive.

notes.title: Wardens latest update features a new map!
notes.notes:
For this update, we have added a new desert themed map to Wardens.
Let us know what you think about it and give it a try by downloading the latest update.

PS. The map will be randomly selected when starting a match.

notes.title: Update notes for Oct 18
notes.notes: Modifying official and verified packs are not allowed anymore, making sure you can play online matches as expected, since modified content causes balancing issues when both players arent playing with the same (expected) content.
